Unlike generic AI consultancies, Stromy brings the maestro's precision: every workflow is composed, every output is publication-ready.

principles: Substance before style — the work speaks; decoration must earn its place.
Orchestration as metaphor — every layout, motif, and typographic choice encodes disparate parts resolved into one coherent system.
Editorial restraint — spacious layouts, measured type scales, ink-and-paper contrast; no visual noise.
Signal economy — indigo is a signal colour, never a flood; a single focal dot carries the accent.
The score made visible — concentric dot-fields and barline rhythm render orchestration as a structural system, not a picture of instruments.

density.note: measured whitespace, generous section spacing; the dot family never crowds a surface

energy.note: ORG-PLAN-195, AUTHORED (owner decision 2026-08-13), superseding a first pass that derived 'restrained'. That derivation leaned on 'ornament: restrained', and ornament is decorative density — it says nothing about movement, which is the distinction this axis exists to draw. Read on its own terms the grammar is emphatic about motion: a named signature moment ('the ensemble rises, then holds'), a dome that assembles, a field that breathes. A brand with a signature MOTION is not a still one. Restraint here lives in the ornament axis, where it belongs.

depth.note: ORG-PLAN-195. Straight from the contrast axis: 'depth carried by colour, shadows deliberately minimal'. That is layered by definition — not flat (colour genuinely carries depth here) and not immersive (a brand that removes its shadows is not asking to be stood inside). Unchanged by the 2026-08-13 review.

materiality.note: ORG-PLAN-195. matte and light are DERIVED: matte from 'documentary-muted, desaturated/high-contrast' plus the deliberately minimal shadows; light from the stage-light radial and the single indigo focal dot — illumination IS the brand's material idea. metal is AUTHORED (owner decision 2026-08-13), not derived: the captured grammar contains no reflective device, and this records a decision that Stromy's one premium moment reads as a worked material. Kept honest deliberately — a reader must be able to tell which of these came from evidence. Still explicitly NOT grain: nothing asks for texture noise, and the anti-pattern against gradient floods argues against it. The only multi-valued core axis.

continuity.note: ORG-PLAN-195, AUTHORED (owner decision 2026-08-13), superseding a first pass that derived 'settle' from the field-breathe behaviour alone. Still true that nothing loops indefinitely — but 'comes to rest' describes one element, while this axis asks when motion may occur across a whole surface. The signature is an ENSEMBLE rising, which is a sequence: each section arrives, settles, and hands to the next. `settle` under-described that as a single event.

signatureElements: Dot-dome — the primary mark: a polar lattice of dots forming an orchestra dome with one indigo focal dot at the podium; the rising-ensemble signature.
Concentric dot-field — rings of dots radiating from a single indigo focal; full-bleed texture for heroes and dividers; drives the field-breathe motion.
Barline measure — abstract vertical barlines with beat-dots and one indigo accent beat; rhythm and structure motif for footers, rails, and content grids.
Misaligned numeral — large Fraunces section numbers split cream/indigo with a deliberate baseline offset; the 'scored' editorial cue.
Space Grotesk wordmark — STROMY set in Space Grotesk 600 with open tracking, rising from the dot-dome; primary identity lockup.
Misaligned secondary lockup — the 'scored' STROMY wordmark for cover slides, home-page heroes, and section openers.
expression.signatureMotion: The dot field breathes once — rings settling outward from the podium — and comes to rest with a single indigo focal dot still lit. The ensemble rises, then holds.
antiPatterns: No literal musical notation — no staves, clefs, or noteheads; orchestration is rendered through abstract dots, not sheet music.
No orange or Claude-adjacent accent — indigo (#61009E) is the only signal colour; the retired oxide/orange must not reappear.
No gradient floods on working surfaces — the stage-light radial is a hero-only device; content and document backgrounds stay flat.
No decorative motif scatter — the dot family is assigned by role (dome=identity, field=texture, barline=rhythm), never sprinkled for taste.
No pure-white document grounds where Cream is specified; no stock-office or AI-futurism imagery.
Never more than one indigo focal dot in a single composition — the signal is singular.
